fields.Name: IT07 - Dataset Cache (DatasetCache category)
fields.Description: Exercises the dataset cache through GetAndCacheDatasetByName. DS1: a cold call populates the cache (IsDatasetCached false->true) and a warm call serves the same dataset. DS2: the status APIs (IsDatasetCached / IsDatasetCacheUpToDate) agree with the warm state. DS3: after ClearDatasetCache both status APIs return false (a cleared dataset is never reported up-to-date). Assertions are behavioral, not counter-based: the dataset cache writes through the provider's own LocalStorageProvider (separate from the instrumented LocalCacheManager), so counters can't observe it on the server. Uses the real seeded 'MJ_Metadata' dataset; no row mutation.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Cold miss writes DatasetCache; warm hit serves with zero writes; status APIs agree; clearing the cache flips both status APIs back to false.
